name: 晴
style_lock: 藏青短发配一缕青色挑染

prompt_lock.zh: 原创日系动漫风格的知识节目主持人：藏青色短发，一缕青色挑染，头顶一根呆毛，青色眼睛，白衬衫配青色领结，墨蓝色短外套；赛璐璐平涂上色，干净的深色细描边，半身正面，表情亲切。
prompt_lock.en: Original anime-style explainer host: short navy hair with a single teal streak and one ahoge, teal eyes, white shirt with a teal bow tie, navy cropped jacket; flat cel shading with clean thin dark outlines, front-facing half-body shot, friendly expression.
